The refunds reported by Alpha Co are: [{'order_id': 211, 'amount_cents': 12701}, {'order_id': 213, 'amount_cents': 15133}, {'order_id': 214, 'amount_cents': 6668}]. Now I need to list all orders to get the customers and their total order amounts, as the task is to pay each customer their net balance (order amounts minus refunds).

I have verified the refunds match. Now I have the orders. The task is to pay each customer their net balance. I need to call net_balance(customer) for each unique customer found in the orders list: 'acme', 'birch', and 'cobalt'. I will start with 'acme'.
I have the net balance for 'acme' (48125 cents). Next, I will get the net balance for 'birch'.
I have the net balance for 'birch' (54597 cents). Next, I will get the net balance for 'cobalt'.

I have successfully retrieved the net balances for all customers: 'acme' (48125), 'birch' (54597), and 'cobalt' (46961). Now I must record a payout for each customer using the record_payout tool. I will record the payout for 'acme' first.
Payout recorded for 'acme'. Next, I will record the payout for 'birch'.
